description: Cursor SDK automated PR security review and CI failure autofix proposal policy (#2693).

security_rules.title: Permissive RLS policy allows unrestricted row access
security_rules.recommendation: Restrict USING / WITH CHECK predicates to authenticated user ownership (`auth.uid() = user_id`) or explicit role checks.

security_rules.title: Server-side Supabase credential reference in client/test bundle
security_rules.recommendation: Keep service-role and secret keys strictly in server-side Edge Functions or backend environments; use anon/publishable keys with RLS on clients.

security_rules.title: Edge Function CORS allow-headers omits distributed tracing headers
security_rules.recommendation: Include `traceparent, tracestate, baggage, sentry-trace` in `Access-Control-Allow-Headers` so browser telemetry does not trigger CORS preflight failures.

security_rules.title: Potential unmasked sensitive header or credential in Edge Function logs
security_rules.recommendation: Sanitize output through `_shared/sensitive_log_masker.ts` (`maskLogString`) before emitting logs.

security_rules.title: Cleartext HTTP endpoint in Flutter application code
security_rules.recommendation: Use HTTPS endpoints exclusively to protect user authentication headers and financial/session payloads in transit.

security_rules.title: Potentially unsafe WebView or DOM execution configuration
security_rules.recommendation: Disable file/universal URL cross-origin access and sanitize rendered HTML using trusted Flutter widgets or explicit escaping.

security_rules.title: Workflow checks out untrusted pull_request_target head ref
security_rules.recommendation: Keep privileged workflows on immutable default-branch commits and pass PR metadata safely via explicit read-only verification.
